description: This file defines a Go struct and associated methods for configuring the status of a Kubernetes PersistentVolume, including fields for phase, message, reason, and transition time, along with builder methods for chaining configuration.

classes.name: PersistentVolumeStatusApplyConfiguration
classes.description: A declarative configuration struct for Kubernetes PersistentVolumeStatus, with fields for phase, message, reason, and transition time.

methods.name: PersistentVolumeStatus()
methods.description: Constructs and returns a new declarative configuration object for PersistentVolumeStatus.

methods.name: WithPhase
methods.description: Sets the phase of the persistent volume status in the configuration, enabling method chaining.

methods.name: WithMessage
methods.description: Sets the message field in the configuration, enabling method chaining.

methods.name: WithReason
methods.description: Sets the reason field in the configuration, enabling method chaining.

methods.name: WithLastPhaseTransitionTime
methods.description: Sets the last phase transition time in the configuration, enabling method chaining.
